_doc: ColituGecko (Colitu's own protocol): gecko-client (cmd/gecko-client of Colitu's PRIVATE repository colituvpn/colitu-gecko, not open source). scripts/build-gecko-sidecar.sh builds it from the pinned commit (CGO off) into gecko-dosyalari/linux-<arch>/gecko-client, which is never committed; scripts/package-linux.sh checks the SHA-256 below and ships it in bin/colitu-gecko/. While 'commit' is empty (the Gecko code is not in a pushed commit yet) the packages ship without it and the app reports 'gecko-client missing' (Gecko stays off).
